cards.title: Borrowed Authority
cards.instruction: Project confident authority while quietly working to keep everyone cooperative. Your confidence depends on their cooperation.

cards.title: I Changed the Odds
cards.instruction: Hide how your own choice tilted the contest, bargain, or consequence while continuing to judge the outcome.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: A fair result. Let's celebrate my cake's first prize.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Why did you move yours under the judging light?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Lighting maintenance. I'll arrange the display now; the judging's finished.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Mine was left in the shade.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Put yours under the light for the photographs. I'll move mine, with its first-prize card.

reason: A grants B better post-judging visibility and takes moving work while keeping the prize won under A earlier tilted lighting arrangement.
